paragraphs: Rav Ashi son of R' Zeira: see his entry. Rabbi Levi son of Rabbi Zeira: Kohelet Rabbah 7:6.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Torat Emet Kohelet Rabbah 7:6 paragraph fully names Rabbi Levi son of Rabbi Zeira, supporting both local titles in that clause and the heading. The separate Rav Ashi pointer was not independently collated; its father’s abbreviated title remains R'. No identification of the fathers across the two pointers is admitted.
